title: Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR)
summary: Specifies CBOR, the Concise Binary Object Representation, a data format designed for very small code size, fairly small messages, and extensibility without version negotiation. This revision obsoletes RFC 7049, providing editorial fixes, clarifications, and some small additions while keeping the format compatible. It is an Internet Standard.

eli5.summary: CBOR is like JSON's compact cousin: a way for computers to pack up data into very small messages that are still easy to unpack.
